scenarios.description: Persist a TestRun-bound two-round research experiment, execute each round through the deterministic isolated Runner Fixture, and publish one immutable result per round.
assertions: Both round jobs are bound to the same owner, TestRun, Experiment and explicit round index.
Each round consumes only its own 40-cent reservation; unused round budget cannot transfer.
Each deterministic Fixture model call settles 23 cents against its own 40-cent round cap; the aggregate is exactly 46 cents.
Each round publishes one content-addressed immutable artifact and retries do not publish duplicates.
Web and CLI inspect the same TestRun and independently recompute the same assertions.

scenarios.description: Reject an experiment whose requested reservation exceeds the TestRun's remaining cap before persisting the Experiment or creating a Runner Job.
assertions: The projected 55-cent commitment is rejected against the exact 50-cent TestRun cap.
The rejection is persisted as scenario evidence while Experiment and budget ledgers remain unchanged.
No Runner Job, model/provider call, market-data call, Paper call or broker call occurs.
A repeated request with the same idempotency identity returns the same rejection without side effects.

scenarios.description: Fail after round 1 checkpoint persistence, take over the expired isolated Runner lease, resume from the exact checkpoint, and reject stale-fence publication.
assertions: Recovery uses the original TestRun, Experiment, round/job identity and exact stored checkpoint hash.
The lease takeover increments the fencing token and the previous fence cannot publish an artifact.
Already settled round work is not charged or published a second time.
Every injected fault is recorded in sequence; the seed alone is not treated as fault evidence.
Web and CLI inspect the same recovered TestRun and independently recompute recovery assertions.
